_about: Live Desmos values and exact error texts for piecewise expressions and restrictions, copied from the function catalogue's ALL.values.json (matrices-advanced family, observed 2026-10-19). Keys keep the catalogue's form: ' ;; ' separates rows defined first, ' [degrees]' marks degree mode. null = undefined. Actions, tickers and matrix cases that use braces are left to those families.
